source.title: General Solution of the ADFGVX Cipher System
source.author: J. Rives Childs
source.message_header_literal: A) NKJ v VLP (07.06 p.m. November 11, 1918); 1430 (11) 5 TLE
source.date_note: The page-heading year 1916 conflicts with the explicitly printed intercept year 1918. Both are retained; the body states 11 November and noon without a year.

prior_reading.title: Deciphering ADFGVX messages from the Eastern Front of World War I
prior_reading.inspected_locator: Author manuscript printed p23, PDF p24 in the inspected ResearchGate-cover copy
prior_reading.scope: The authors explicitly discuss Childs p178 A and B, identifying the armistice cease-fire order, MMD, Navy Special Command, U-boat instructions, self-defense and requested neutral-water passage. This package does not claim those body identifications as new.
prior_reading.our_contribution: Full literal German source edition, explicit two short-group insertion hypotheses, coordinate-repair costs, unresolved numeric domains, and reproducible arithmetic certificate.
